meta_description: Rusty’s Towing, LLC serving Florence - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Florence, and straight answers.
hero_lede: Towing service in Florence. Recent jobs are on the photos page.
explore_h2: Stuck, stranded, or off the road
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Florence.
about_p1: Broke down in Florence SC. Rusty’s Towing was recommended. Fast friendly and professional, Rusty went beyond just hauling my truck to a repair shop. He recommended a local rental shop and helped me get there too. Safe clean trucks and service with a smile on your day of need!! Thank you Rusty!!
about_p2: I had run into an issue with F250 and needed to get my truck into the shop. I called around to a few towing company’s in the area and when I called Rustys towing he was absolutely great and kind. I was having a pretty rough day but he did a lot to help me and my family even offering to hold my Uhaul trailer at his yard. If you need any kind of towing needs call Rustys Towing he’ll get the job done.
area_h2: Florence and the area around it
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

reviews.author: Scott Neal
reviews.text: Broke down in Florence SC. Rusty’s Towing was recommended. Fast friendly and professional, Rusty went beyond just hauling my truck to a repair shop. He recommended a local rental shop and helped me get there too. Safe clean trucks and service with a smile on your day of need!! Thank you Rusty!!

reviews.author: Luhama Loketi
reviews.text: I had run into an issue with F250 and needed to get my truck into the shop. I called around to a few towing company’s in the area and when I called Rustys towing he was absolutely great and kind. I was having a pretty rough day but he did a lot to help me and my family even offering to hold my Uhaul trailer at his yard. If you need any kind of towing needs call Rustys Towing he’ll get the job done.

reviews.author: Kylie McGinnis
reviews.text: Rusty was an absolute lifesaver!! My Husband and me (20 and 21) were over 2 hours away from home heading to the beach when our tire blew on 95 he was there in less than 30 minutes and helped us with putting the new tire on he was so incredibly kind not with only what he has done for us but just by the person he was! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Greg Williams
reviews.text: Rusty from Rusty’s towing company was a big help in getting me and my family out of a terrible situation. He was very friendly and helpful and treated us like family while getting our car to where it needed to be. Rusty’s tow truck company is a 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Aaron Geyer
reviews.text: Rusty was readily available, honest, and very compassionate after our accident. He provided excellent customer service and even helped us retrieve some items from our vehicle. So grateful for his time, assistance, and most of all his empathy. Highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Melanie Mann
reviews.text: I was in the company car and broke down in the Florence area. Rusty's son came to the rescue! This young man could not have been any nicer to me. I was so thankful he was able to get the car and myself back to Myrtle Beach. You can definitely tell his parents have raised him to be very respectful. I can't say enough about how kind he was. I would recommend Rusty's towing to anyone that needs help.

reviews.author: James Livingston
reviews.text: Excellent service! Went above and beyond to assist me with my 2 vehicles. Unmatched customer service!!

reviews.author: Laurie L
reviews.text: Rusty's Towing came out and helped my daughter out after she accidentally jumped a curb in her car. I highly recommend this company! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Blake s
reviews.text: He towed a vehicle for a coworker of mine and I came from Greenville to Florence to pick it up. He used his rollback and sat the vehicle on my trailer for me. Also helped chain the vehicle down, then offered me a sink to wash my hands and water to drink, without asking for another dime. He also made time for all this on a sunday. Very personable and respectful. Would definately recommend!

reviews.author: Meredith Mahon
reviews.text: Rusty is the BEST! I had an emergency and needed to be towed, and of course I was in a difficult spot to be towed. He maneuvered my car with care, and got it to the repair shop quickly. Rusty is a pleasure to work with. 10/10 would highly recommend him and his team!

reviews.author: David Henry
reviews.text: Great people performing great service, his son was a true gentleman and Rusty followed through on all things he said he would. I was stranded driving from Florida to N.Y. They became my guide and advocate on trying to get my vehicle repaired. FIVE STARS all the way.

reviews.author: MiMi Byrd-Starr
reviews.text: Rusty’s Towing is one of the best companies to call if you need automotive assistance. Mr Rusty is kind, respectful, courteous, & philanthropic also. He towed my friend, but I will recommend his services to everyone!

reviews.author: JoJo N
reviews.text: Was stranded in an unfamiliar area over an hour away from home on a sunday and couldnt find any mechanics open to get us back on the road. I was reccomended to call Rusty for help. He was AMAZING!!!! Even though he was busy with his current workload for the day he took the time out to help me find someone who was able to drive out to me and get me back on the road home safely. He is the true definition of southern hospitality and i know if im ever stranded in florence again Rusty is there to help or point me in the right direction! I was back on the road less than an hour after our first call and I couldnt be more grateful to have someone like him looking out for me. He took a horribly stressful situation for me and lifted the weight right off my shoulders. He will always be my first recommendation to others and my first phone call if im ever experiencing car issues in his area again.

reviews.author: Koop Koop
reviews.text: Man the best in the city, well manned everybody is extremely nice. I love rusty towing, please don’t hesitate to call RUSTYS TOWING for your towing needs, I promise ya he will get you right

reviews.author: Makenna Tysinger
reviews.text: Rusty’s towing was great! We got a flat tire 3 hours from home and weren’t able to change it and he was extremely helpful. He kept us updated by phone and text while he was on the way and was quick to get to us! He was so kind and made us feel much better about the whole process. He gave us the choice of where we wanted the car to go to get fixed as well. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area!

reviews.author: Will C
reviews.text: This man and his company are as good as they come. I had a roadside emergency where I needed to be towed and upon the first call he set up a time and was prompt in getting to me. He towed my car with care and expertise and made me and my family feel like we were in great hands. If you use this service just know you and your car are in great hands.

reviews.author: Kaitin Earnest
reviews.text: Such amazing service! I was stuck in a genuinely tight spot on the instate mid-construction zone & Rusty's was able to get my vehicle quickly to a safe location. He also provided excellent recommendations for local mechanics. Absolutely give him a call if you find yourself in need of a tow!

reviews.author: Joni Wireman
reviews.text: We needed our vehicle towed out of the road to a motel. He had previously gave us a number for a guy to help with the car but the guy ended up messing our car up worse. So after hours of being broke down. He said to my boyfriend, your not gonna let him fix your car and wouldnt tow it. We just wanted to go to a room and rest. He and the other man are some kind of scammers. Do NOT use them!

reviews.author: Jesse Schuster
reviews.text: We were involved in an accident on our way to a long weekend vacation. One of the other people involved had contacted Rusty for their vehicle and when he showed up, he checked on everyone involved, asked if we had contacted a tow and waited for us to figure out our plans and then provided us a tow and drove us to the Enterprise in Florence! I cannot say enough about how kind and professional Rusty and his family are. When we had to release our vehicle from his lot to the repair shop, he asked how we were all doing and how our trip was. Rusty is next level customer service; I would give more than 5 stars! Thank You Rusty!

reviews.author: Jo Korby
reviews.text: I cannot find enough words to express our gratitude for the services we received from Rusty. Having sat along the freeway for 2 hours waiting for help from 2 other companies who failed to show or communicate with us, Rusty was there in a heartbeat, had us secured in his cab, our car up on the flatbed and safely off the freeway within minutes. He is such a caring and professional individual. He is top notch. I would not recommend anyone else. Thank you so much Rusty. You are the best at what you do.

reviews.author: Wayne Lawson
reviews.text: Our truck broke down on the highway and he got to us quickly. He was incredibly helpful and went out of his way to accommodate us. Made a sressful situation a little better. Amazing service. Thank you so much Rusty!

reviews.author: Cheyenne Greenwood
reviews.text: Rusty was extremely helpful when our car broke down on the highway. He even messaged us the next day to make sure we were okay! He made sure we felt safe and is such a sweetheart. Great prices, great service, and great man.

reviews.author: Catherine Poston
reviews.text: Rusty is amazing! Our trusty Honda left us stranded at a service station with a newborn and a 2 year old on our way to visit our parents in Hilton Head. While panicking and waiting for another truck for forever, Rusty happened to pull up and was able to get us going, on the road, with recommendations on what to do next in just a few minutes. In the middle of our breakdown, he was a shining light and we are so so grateful! Can't recommend enough!

reviews.author: Cortney Mendoza
reviews.text: I recently was in a really bad accident with my son. And the police just so happened to call Rusty's Towing and I am so happy they did. I didn't know the next step at all. I called Rusty and the first thing he said is how are you and your son. I'm sure he sees a million people a day and he remembered us! He helped me with what was going to happen next with my car. When it came time that I had to get all of my belongings out of my car because it was a total loss, he made time for me to come do so. He helped me get everyone out of the car. He was so kind and helpful! He didn't even mind my crazy kids running around lol. Highly, HIGHLY recommend!!

reviews.author: Natasha Wright
reviews.text: After having 5 other companies try to tow my Mercedes-Benz, Rusty was able to get my car on the truck bed without a scratch. His ease, quickness, and professionalism is unmatched! Would recommend his services to any and everyone!

reviews.author: Alyssa Solari
reviews.text: Rusty was great today. With all the rain we’ve had my car got bogged down in the yard. Tried to use the 4 wheel drive to get it out but that started sinking too. Rusty showed up with a smile on his face ready to help. Got it out in under 5 minutes at a great price. He was friendly and professional. Would absolutely use his services again if ever needed!

reviews.author: Jessica Heman-Ackah
reviews.text: Had an AWESOME experience with Rusty. First time I've ever had to be towed and he definitely set the expectations high if it is to ever happen again. He made us feel very safe and was super informative and helpful throughout the whole process.

reviews.author: Jm. B.
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I were stranded 2 hours away from home and Rusty helped us so quickly! He got to us in 10 minutes, referred us to black’s tires who also got us in or out. Rusty was so friendly and we couldn’t thank him enough

reviews.author: Deangela Mazique
reviews.text: Very reliable and kind. Will definitely recommend for services. Needed to get my lug nut off my tire to change it because it was scripted and stuck on. It was 1am and I had my 3 children in the car along with my mother. Rusty did not hesitate. He came right away. If it wasn't for him, we would still be out there. Thank you Rusty. I really do appreciate it.

reviews.author: Abby Elizondo
reviews.text: Rusty is so professional and so nice he really came through in our time of need we are from Florida and we had a blow out on 95 N near Florence and he came through for us so quickly and efficiently compared to our roadside assistance he could not even help us out and got all 3 of us to safe destination. I really appreciate all he did for us and I highly recommend anyone to use his services if needed. You wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Crystal Hodges
reviews.text: Rusty’s is amazing and tries to work with you. He helped me and my fiancé when we got into a car accident. He even brought us our car the next day for a good price.

reviews.author: Travis Anderson
reviews.text: I had been pulled over late one night and my insurance had lapsed. I was required to be towed. Mr. Russell was so polite and kind. He was a true blessing to me. One of the best people I’ve ever met.

reviews.author: Susan Wilson Midgett
reviews.text: Rusty saved the day! In the middle of a huge rainstorm, our windshield wipers went out and we were stranded on the side of the highway. Rusty was the only towing service who answered the phone at 9:30 pm and agreed to come help us. He went the extra mile and kept us calm in an extraordinarily stressful situation and his rates were extremely reasonable. We could not recommend Rusty enough!!

reviews.author: Joseph Kribs
reviews.text: Amazing guy, family, and service. I can't say enough about Rusty's. I was in an accident in SC while driving up to NY. He got me to a hotel, then the next day helped me pack up my stuff from my totaled car into my rental. He even attached a cable from his tow truck to peel back a piece of my trunk that was pinning down my Yeti cooler and we were able to get it out of the demolished trunk.

reviews.author: Chris Moss
reviews.text: I hit a patch of gravel this evening and went into a steep ditch. Rusty came out in a timely fashion and pulled my truck out quick. The price was great and Rusty was a very kind and honest man. If you are ever in need of a towing service please call Rusty!

reviews.author: Duwayne Trapp
reviews.text: Rustys towing did a fantastic job. He made sure our vehicle got to the dealership in Darlington SC. He also could handle 4 adults in his tow truck. Also his price was very reasonable. I would definitely use him if I was ever in Florence or the Darlington area.

reviews.author: Will Kimbro
reviews.text: We were on the way to the beach Pulling a 15K fifth wheel and blew a cold side pipe on our diesel. When I went to pull off of road, The truck slid into a small ditch and we were stuck. Called Rusty’s towing and by the time I had Replaced the pipe, he was there and was able to pull us out of the ditch without tearing up anything which was a miracle. After a bath for the camper and truck, it’ll be like it never happened. Super nice and professional. He was a real vacation saver. Thanks Rusty.

reviews.author: Daez Tra
reviews.text: Where do I begin?! Over the weekend, I was stranded. So while sitting in the hot car in the hot sun, I searched for towing companies. I have towing with my insurance company, but whoever they call tend to take a very long time to come, and I did not have the time to wait for a truck. So I kept searching and came across many companies. BUT, Randy's Towing had the best reviews. For me, reviews matter especially when a business transaction is going to be conducted. So with his amazing reviews and great comments, I gave him a call...before 8:00 am on a Saturday morning (sorry Randy)! He was soooo pleasant and said that he could send one of his guys immediately. Well his guy was not available, so he came himself. He kept me updated with his location, and the time that it would take to get to me. When he came in less than 30 minutes, he was very nice, respectful, and concerned. He ensured that my car was not hitting or touching the ground as he was lifting it on the truck. That was priceless, because most towing companies, do not care for your vehicle, and will damage it. He asked where I wanted my car towed and I told him. He even asked if I needed to ride in the truck with him. Randy beat me to the dealership!! I was visiting from out of town and had car trouble. I am now back in business and will DEFINITELY use and recommend Randy and his business to others!! Thanks again Randy for the stellar service that you displayed when I needed it the most!!

reviews.author: Reese Rossi
reviews.text: I was in a pickle unable to start my car, was recommended Rusty, he came started my car totally free of charge. Incredible human and a selfless individual. Can’t say enough good things.

reviews.author: Athena Franco
reviews.text: My husband and I unfortunately were in an accident on I-95. We made it to the Florence exit and found Rusty through Google. Not only did they respond quickly, they went out of their way to help us find a hotel in the area that was pet-friendly as we were traveling with our dog. After we got back on our way, Rusty called to check up on us. It felt like they as a family were really looking out for us, they did everything they could to help us. I’ll never forget their kindness!

reviews.author: Alan Huffman
reviews.text: My wife, mother in law, 2 kids were broke down on side of the road on there way to myrtle beach. This guy not only picked them up and got them to there hotel over an hour away safely, he also is taking care of getting our car where it needs to go to get it fixed. I cannot safe enough for this co company. I would highly recommend!!!!!!!!! Thank you for taking good care of what means the most to me!!

reviews.author: Joseph Sallenger
reviews.text: Wound up in a ditch avoiding an uninsured dog. A passing motorist stopped and we asked for advice on a towing service. 20 minutes later Mr. Rusty Ard was hooking us up, getting us on our way, and even provided some body shop options (one of which we chose). Very fair, very friendly, very good local reputation. Who says word of mouth is no longer useful!?

reviews.author: Margaret Hammond
reviews.text: Rusty took excellent care of me and my car, he was extra cautious the the front of my car did not get scratched. it's rare to find such a strong work ethic these days. Thank you Rusty. Margaret West

reviews.author: Peter Battaglioli
reviews.text: Nice, honest, and very helpful. Got me and my car off the side of the road and to the repair shop super fast. Price was right, too. Highly recommended! Thanks, Rusty!

reviews.author: Kady Morris
reviews.text: Was in a bad wreck the day before thanksgiving. Car was totaled. Called rusty's they where on scene, loaded my car and cleaned crash sight. He didnt hesitate to come to get my car he was there in a timely matter. He not only cared about just getting my car he kept asking if me and my kids where all right. He is not your regular tow company he actually cares about his customers and there satisfaction. If you need a tow and want respect and in a timely matter call him for sure.

reviews.author: Zoe Knight
reviews.text: first time ever getting into an accident and within 10 minutes of being called Rusty came along. Fastest services i've ever recieved ! Very polite, reasonable rates, EXCELLENT SERVICE!! I RECOMMEND RUSTY'S TOWING!!!

reviews.author: carrie huffman
reviews.text: Cannot tell you how incredibly blessed we have been tonight to have Rusty Towing come to our rescue. Me and my mom set out on an adventure to the beach with my 2 small boys (under 5) and made it to florence when my car broke down. They went over and BEYOND to ensure we were safe and got to our hotel an hour away! Cannot get over how incredibly kind they were to us tonight. Thank you so much!!!! Would definitely reccomend their services!!!!!!

reviews.author: orval walker
reviews.text: My car broke down on I95 about 15 miles north of Florence while on my way from Florida to N.C. My insurance company called another tow company and after waiting 2 hours they cancelled saying the tow was to short and they wouldn't make any money. Then they called Rusty's, this guy was there within an hour (thank god cuz us Florida boys were freezing out butts off) and towed me to the next exit. Then he told me if I couldn't get my car running to give him a call and he would tow it back to Florence and put it in his yard until I figured out what to do and just charge me for the tow. Well I got it running the next morning, simple issue, that afternoon I received a text from a local number. It was Rusty checking to make sure we got things squared away . If you need any tow service in that area this guy is the best. Thanks Rusty!! From Orv and Ethan

reviews.author: Timothy Corsnitz
reviews.text: Rusty is the best towing service in the state. Takes care of the coustmer and the property very respectful responsible and 100% on time with the fastest service. Love the rusty towing family.

reviews.author: Mike Cummings
reviews.text: We were coming in from out of town and our car blowed up. We knew no one, and had no idea what we were going to do. We thank God we found Rusty. He was there within 15 minutes, he helped us find somewhere to take it ,and went out of his way to get us there. Didn’t even charge us extra for going above and beyond. Thanks Rusty! May God bless you guys!

reviews.author: Frank Alderson
reviews.text: We broke down in the middle of nowhere, 70 miles from our destination, we called Rusty and he was there in no time. He was very friendly and professional. Would definitely use him again.

reviews.author: tiffiany nelson
reviews.text: Rusty's Tow service is amazing! Gave me plenty of options to get a disabled car towed from one residence to another. Customer service was on point! These guys will be my new go to for towing!

reviews.author: Andrew Glover
reviews.text: I was fortunate to have met both him and his son. Words can't describe how concern and knowledgeable they were to provide help on Memorial Day. I will always consider them a friend. Thanks Andrew

reviews.author: Barclay Hayes
reviews.text: Prompt Response, Very Reasonably Priced, Friendly and Helpful. Thanks Rusty, you are Now my Go To Guy.

reviews.author: Liza Calhoun
reviews.text: The most kind man! I’m a single young woman and he made me feel so safe and comfortable. If you need a tow, call Rusty’s!!

reviews.author: Ken Smith
reviews.text: Rusty was the second tow company, and even though he was on a tow already, he contacted another company to come to my truck and trailer. Very professional and polite.

reviews.author: brice hall
reviews.text: Great people. Rusty is very knowledgeable about his business and is compassionate and truely seems to care about the people he helps. Fair and honest service.

reviews.author: Melissa Douglass
reviews.text: Excellent service!! The only tow people I will ever use again!! Polite, friendly and the best people to ever do business with and I have used alot of tows before. Hands down the best!! Also they have great prices. Why would you use anyone else?!

reviews.author: A. Singh
reviews.text: Called him to get my car towed came within 5 mins and he dropped me back all the way to where I live, really good guy, if you ever need a towing call him!

reviews.author: Fredrica Cooper
reviews.text: I recommend Rusty to anyone. Best service, real friendly and down the earth guy. Rusty was really fast with getting my boyfriend car. I really appreciate it Rusty.

reviews.author: J James
reviews.text: I called after my mom sat for hours waiting on a tow and Rusty Towing got to us in no time! He was so kind to my family and very professional! Great service!!!

reviews.author: Tameka Clavon
reviews.text: Rusty was very friendly very polite and very helpful with trying to figure out what was wrong with my car. Rusty you have a customer for life! EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE! !

reviews.author: Natalie Clavette
reviews.text: Got stuck on a busy highway with no where to change a tire. Towed us, changed the tire for us, and even filled with air and made sure it didn’t have any leaks! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Kiyana Bland
reviews.text: Very nice people , I had no problems getting in contact and timing was awesome too. I will be using their services again.

reviews.author: Walter Burch
reviews.text: Rusty was awesome. I hit a deer, car was toast in the middle of nowhere. Very nice and professional. Highly recommend

reviews.author: kendell page
reviews.text: It was cold, wet, dark, raining and I'm stuck in the yard. Called Rusty Towing and in 15min I was pulled out. Great service all the way around.

reviews.author: Tattooqueen99
reviews.text: Very polite, nice and very helpful in bad situations. So happy I was lucky enough to be helped but a kind hearted person like him.

reviews.author: yoine castro
reviews.text: excellent person, my truck broke down and when Rusty arrived he didn't tow it, he fixed it and I was able to drive home.

reviews.author: Jamie Floyd
reviews.text: Never fails I need a tow and Rusty is very dependable and quick responding to my calls .He will go out his way to help anyone!! You will be very pleased !!!!!

reviews.author: Alaise Ellis
reviews.text: Locked keys in car and spare wasn’t working.. called Rusty’s and had my kids n the blink of an eye.... thanks so much... will definitely recommend 100 times over

reviews.author: Richard Strawn
reviews.text: Referred to this company for a family member who was broken down while traveling on vacation. The owner went above and beyond helping the stranded family. Customer Service still exist in the world! Thank you

reviews.author: GFTL SERVICES
reviews.text: Best towers around Real good people and easy to work with too! i wouldnt call nobody but Rustys everytime

reviews.author: Brandon Anderson
reviews.text: Very respectful and polite!! Got to us very quick and even help us find out what problem was to help fix problem. Would recommend everytime need service if your in area

reviews.author: William Wallace
reviews.text: Absolutely one of the best!! Great service and professional work. Really polite and true to his word. HIGHLY RECOMMEND !!

reviews.author: Franco
reviews.text: If you are in the kind of situation where you need a tow, Rusty, Tanya and Russell are exactly the kind of people you need to call. I cannot over emphasize how much they helped us.

reviews.author: Brittney Farland
reviews.text: I was stuck on the side of the road, not even 10 min after calling rusty was there, a complete gentleman and was quick getting me hooked up and to the gas station. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Pinkni Robinson
reviews.text: I am so truly happy I found Mr Ard the fact he came and got my car took me home was nothing more than a blessing such a wonderful man such a wonderful Spirit truly a great person!!!

reviews.author: Amber Garrington
reviews.text: Excellent service! Was able to tow our F250 long bed truck with no problems. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Wayne Witzel
reviews.text: Broke down on the side of I95 just north of Florence. Responded quickly, friendly, and got us towed to our shop without any issues.

reviews.author: Andy Bateman
reviews.text: Came and got me in absolutely terrible stop and Go traffic on I-95 and dispite that greeted me with a smile and helpful attitude. Best tow I've ever had.

reviews.author: Key Bracey
reviews.text: Best customer service very professional nice guy and he has reasonable prices. I will definitely use his services again.

reviews.author: Nick Diako
reviews.text: Honest, good, people!! I can't recommend Rusty enough! It is a rarity to meet a company with such quality nowadays.

reviews.author: Stephen Mbugua
reviews.text: Very nice and quick to help. Went above and beyond to help me 100% recommend if ever in a sticky situation

reviews.author: taniqua howell
reviews.text: Very respectful and fast! Even helped find out what the problem was! Thank you for your services Mr.Rusty

reviews.author: Brethren Campbell
reviews.text: I was stuck on highway 3a nobody came ,called every one only rusty Rustys to the rescue. God go with him

reviews.author: Dennis Godbolt
reviews.text: The service was just awesome!!!! I won't call anyone else. His service is just that dam good!!!!!! The best!!!!!

reviews.author: willards Cleaning Service
reviews.text: Amazon Customer Service. He's a man of his word, and that's very hard to find. He loves what he does, and he is totally a blessing to the service industry.
